cover_blocks_forced_pos_iters_flag_contr.readback_explanation: --physics_fixes=-solver leaves physxScene:minPositionIterationCount at 1 (not 16), and --g2_force_pos_iters 1 authors solverPositionIterationCount = 1 on all 6 dynamic RigidObjects (vs 16 in cover_blocks_iters16_nosolver) and on both X5 ArticulationRoots (vs 8 in cover_blocks_iters16_nosolver). solver_scene_readback (audit/harness/readback_spec.py:218-221) still reports 16 because IsaacLab's modify_rigid_body_properties applies PhysxSchema.PhysxRigidBodyAPI to the 22 X5 child link prims without authoring solverPositionIterationCount, and stage.Traverse() reads that schema's unauthored fallback 16 on those articulation links (unlike run_harness.py:771, which filters '/robot' out). In PhysX, PxArticulationLink has no solver iteration count (only PxRigidDynamic and PxArticulationReducedCoordinate set iteration counts), so lowering the 6 rigid objects (16 -> 1) and both articulation roots (8 -> 1) changes settled_state before contact and lets the closing fingers pass straight through all 3 cups (35.4847 mm vs 2.024 mm, score 0.0 vs 100.0).
